summary.headline: Decans and Porphyry’s Astrological Chapters
summary.text: Astrological interpretations for the decans of Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by critical apparatus for Porphyry’s chapters on bright fixed stars and co-rising powers, and on Egyptian and Ptolemaic terms and bright and shadowy degrees.
